lesson_title: Six Districts, One Paper: Paper 1 Essentials
hook_text: 70 of Paper 1's 150 marks live in just TWO topics. Here's the map the top scripts revise from.
clip_script: Picture Paper 1 as a city with six districts, and the mark weighting as the size of each district. Functions and graphs: thirty-five marks. Calculus: thirty-five. Algebra and equations: twenty-five. Number patterns: twenty-five. Finance: fifteen. Probability: fifteen. Seventy of the one hundred and fifty marks live in just two districts — functions and calculus — so revision hours should lean there. But the first twenty-five, the algebra opener, are the most routine marks on the paper. Bank them calmly and the paper opens with momentum.
visual_style: A stylised city map unfolding: six districts sized by their mark weight, functions and calculus towering as skyscraper blocks, a glowing route line entering through the small tidy algebra gate and sweeping through all six.
mood: Strategic, heist-planning energy — the blueprint before the job.
pacing: Steady map reveal district by district, a beat on the seventy-mark pair, brisk close on the entry route.
call_to_action: Watch the full revision lesson and walk into Paper 1 owning the map.
